title: Mara and the Gravity
author: Juniper Crane
blurb: Odile Sandoval, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
